description:
This change streamlines the CI/CD surface and cleans up related build and documentation paths.

Key updates:
- simplify container scanning and remove legacy scanner-specific install paths and targets
- tighten GitHub Actions workflow permissions and checkout handling
- pin workflow actions and add lint support for custom runner labels
- reduce publish workflow blast radius and separate cache usage by workflow purpose
- remove obsolete workflows and stale references
- clean up docs, Makefile targets, and local dependency guidance to match the current pipeline

This is intended as a repo-wide pipeline cleanup and consistency pass across workflows, build helpers, and supporting documentation.
